title: Skipped characters, bounds, and the underlying reader position
summary: The global bound now limits the underlying skip to three. A mark with a two-character read-ahead limit stopped reads at two, but skip advanced the same delegate to four.

change.description: Positive skip requests are capped by the remaining global bound and the position advances by the count the delegate actually skipped.

notes: The read predicate checks markedAt and readAheadLimit. The landed skip predicate uses only the global remaining count. Direct delegate read distinguishes positions 2 and 4.
